content.en: Import and export controls are tools used by the government to regulate international trade. **Tariffs** are taxes on imported goods, while **Non-Tariff Barriers (NTBs)** include quotas, licensing requirements, and technical standards. These measures are designed to protect domestic producers, ensure food security, and manage the **Balance of Payments**.
